title: Supplemental water-heating devices.
officialText:
Potable water-heating devices that utilize refrigerant-to-water heat exchangers shall
be approved and installed in accordance with the New York City Plumbing Code and the manufacturer’s installation instructions.
SECTION MC 1003
PRESSURE VESSELS
